question: A student is experimenting with two pure intrinsic crystal samples: Silicon (Energy band gap $E_g = 1.1 \text{ eV}$) and Diamond ($E_g = 5.4 \text{ eV}$). Both samples are initially kept in complete darkness at absolute zero, acting as perfect insulators. They are then illuminated by a monochromatic ultraviolet light source emitting photons of wavelength $\lambda = 300 \text{ nm}$. Based on Band Theory, what will be the effect on the electrical conductivity of these two materials? (Take $h = 6.63 \times 10^{-34} \text{ J s}$, $c = 3 \times 10^8 \text{ m/s}$, and $1 \text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \text{ J}$).

options.A: Both Silicon and Diamond will show a significant increase in conductivity.
options.B: Only Silicon will show an increase in conductivity, while Diamond remains an insulator.
options.C: Only Diamond will show an increase in conductivity, while Silicon remains unaffected.
options.D: Neither material will show any change in electrical conductivity.
